visual_review: Current drawing was a round head with two ring ears on a bust (read as a mouse); the original is a clown head. Redrawn as the original's head only: small rounded top hat on a hairline, one big puff of hair each side, a scalloped fringe, circular jaw and a round nose. Reviewed at 48px in light and dark. Human reference: icon_set/references/human_ref/user.svg (touching head/body contact). No useful Lucide match beyond user-round.
